description: This Java interface defines methods related to retrieving an entity as JSON, optionally specifying a JSON schema version. It is part of the package for handling signals in the Eclipse Ditto project, providing default implementations that return empty Optionals.

classes.name: WithOptionalEntity
classes.description: An interface for entities that can return their JSON representation optionally, with support for different JSON schema versions.

methods.name: getEntity()
methods.description: Returns the entity as JSON using the latest schema version, wrapped in an Optional.

methods.name: getEntity(JsonSchemaVersion schemaVersion)
methods.description: Returns the entity as JSON for the specified schema version, wrapped in an Optional; default implementation returns Optional.empty().
